parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set protocols bfd.explanation: 启用BFD（双向转发检测）协议。

set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family inet address 10.1.1.2/24
set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet bfd-liveness-detection minimum-interval [parameter3]
set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family inet bfd-liveness-detection minimum-interval 300
set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置BFD存活检测的最小间隔时间。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

parameters.name: minimum-interval
parameters.explanation: BFD存活检测的最小间隔时间，单位为毫秒。

set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet bfd-liveness-detection multiplier [parameter3]
set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family inet bfd-liveness-detection multiplier 3

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

parameters.name: multiplier
parameters.explanation: BFD存活检测的乘数，用于计算检测超时时间。
